mapper.select: SELECT notification_id AS notificationId, noti_type AS notiType, status, target_tel AS targetTel, sent_at AS sentAt, share_token AS shareToken, token_expires_at AS tokenExpiresAt FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sent_at DESC

SELECT notification_id AS notificationId, noti_type AS notiType, status, target_tel AS targetTel, sent_at AS sentAt, share_token AS shareToken, token_expires_at AS tokenExpiresAt FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND notification_id = #{notificationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION (user_id, session_id, noti_type, status, target_tel, share_token, token_expires_at, sent_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{notiType}, #{status}, #{targetTel}, #{shareToken}, #{tokenExpiresAt}, NOW())
